author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited — RCE in PHP core hits Drupal/Joomla/Magento/WordPress. Also on CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9, actively exploited). Patch on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18+ / 6.1.3.10+ / 6.4.2.12+ now.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited: Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup Oct 27: CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli / Node.js / Bun) CVSS 7.3 buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder allows remote unauthenticated attacks.

author: windowsforum
text: Over 1,400 CVEs in one Patch Tuesday; patch actively exploited CVE-2026-96951 first.

author: BlockbuzzHunter
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet 4.8.3 patches a high-severity flaw that let malicious servers manipulate pending Bitcoin transactions and redirect funds, after Bitcoin theft.

author: chris_uk2026
text: CISA has added the AI-discovered PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) to its KEV catalog. Active wild exploits confirmed.

author: Techjunkie_Aman
text: PS5 jailbreak: potential 14.00/14.10 exploit (Prolapse), an AI-discovered hypervisor bug, $50K HackerOne bounty; patched by 14.20.

author: eapyk
text: Newly disclosed MCP vulnerability: on October 25 an advisory revealed an SSRF bypass in mcp-server-fetch, a tool that allows AI agents to fetch URLs, due to two components parsing the same URL differently.

author: AmirZak6
text: I found RCE on the sandboxes of Instinct and Muse personal AI agents.

author: shoebhakim
text: Researchers demonstrated an exploit against AI coding agents like OpenAI Codex and Claude Code by dropping a malicious AGENTS.md file into a user's ~/Downloads (prompt injection).

author: showxlate
text: Security report: prompt-injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability plus active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials via a malicious GitHub repository.

author: AgentSecIndex
text: Agent security index Oct 18-24, CVE note: Docker MCP Gateway.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked; five months later an attacker exploited it to poison a release.

author: so_sthbryan
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack pushed malicious packages to PyPI and Docker using stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens; info-stealer steals credentials. Rotate all secrets.

author: pragenticAI
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack: malicious PyPI package designed to steal cloud credentials and AI API keys. Check for version 1.107.0.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets from thousands of developer repositories.

author: matricedigitale
text: Gheist steals GitHub secrets: 13,500 malicious branches and 850 compromised accounts.

author: B2bCyber
text: Microsoft Threat Intelligence confirmed an active supply chain attack on the ConnectWise Cloud Backup OAuth application; attacker obtained customer access tokens.

author: EpochTimes
text: Microsoft: a China-aligned hacking group used an AI tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including the ConnectWise compromise.

author: martypartymusic
text: Major cyberattack on GMO Internet Group's Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service used for automated FX trading; attackers compromised the cloud/VPS service and obtained logins.

author: whodeven
text: Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm: revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Kill persistence before rotating keys.

author: devops_nk
text: October incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw, Railway customer secrets exposure, LiteLLM malicious PyPI + Docker releases, Zeabur infrastructure breached, OpenCode AI API keys exposed, OVHcloud CLI backdoored.

author: Shivamshahi77
text: UK AI Security Institute and Anthropic published analyses of a July test in which Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on a real open-source project.

author: endurasecurity
text: Four supply chain attacks in October 2026 shipped through trusted channels with valid signatures, then went for build credentials.

author: getdeskcrew
text: SolarWinds Web Help Desk zero-day alerts hit support feeds.

author: artifocial
text: Two PHP bugs (PHP2Shell), every version since 2012, ~70% of websites, unauthenticated RCE. Governments took sites offline to patch; Cloudflare saw millions of exploit attempts in a day. Both bugs were found by frontier AI models.

author: bigfishtec
text: PHP2Shell is being exploited in the wild! Critical PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) could enable Remote Code Execution. Patch affected systems and check for suspicious activity.

author: me_deepu
text: CISA has now put both PHP2Shell bugs on its Known Exploited list. US agencies have until Oct 29 to fix them, with forensic triage on top. Updating WordPress or plugins won't fix this; the bug is in PHP itself.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cloudflare reports exploitation of two critical PHP RCE flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. PHP issued fixes; Aikido offers free backported container images for older branches.

author: Dinosn
text: UK Biobank prepares to reopen research platform following major data breach.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: CISA adds PHP2Shell flaws CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to the CISA KEV catalog after confirmed RCE and suspected DPRK-linked scanning.

author: ACMarketsLive
text: Japan's GMO Internet told clients to disconnect computers ahead of a feared midday cyberattack, after a breach of its MT4/MT5 cloud desktop service triggered unauthorised trades at 70+ forex firms.

author: intels_daily
text: Unverified claim: threat actor 'honeyman1' claims to offer malware involving PHP, Apache and MadGPT, citing CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

author: HomeLabCipher
text: CISA just put PHP on its exploited list. Two flaws in it now count as actively exploited, not just theoretical.

author: Neome_com
text: Keystone breach deepens: hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine.

author: SuleimanAmeer1
text: Hacker exploits critical PHP2Shell flaws to win $2,000 Bitcoin challenge, releases PoC.

author: neo_logos_
text: 24h recap: Genesys said hackers accessed internal business systems and likely downloaded CRM data; cloud platforms not compromised. ScarlettGroup claimed the attack.
